{{Quote|Where the Jedi failed, we prevail. For the honor of King, planet, and Empire!|King's Own Guard|<ref name="LIV" />}}
The '''King's Own Guard''' was an elite paramilitary unit within the [[Lazerian army]]. They maintained their own military installation, and were assigned to guard the [[Crystal Valley (Lazerian IV)|Crystal Valley]]. In the early years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the King's Own Guard was commanded by [[Alroy Kever]]. The unit had existed for centuries, and their traditions and methods had been maintained for generations, and the unit had a chivalric code of their own. The King's Own Guard were the best trained and most efficient [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the Lazarian military. Members of the King's Own Guard worn [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and helmets, and were armed with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]. They also carried a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]], and a [[pocket computer]].
